zones.title: Dealers
zones.body: Rows from ar_mock_dealers, narrowed by market, dealerId and city (accent-insensitive).

zones.title: Slots
zones.body: Dealer row from ar_mock_dealers; slots deterministic from dealerId and date so tests repeat (the one Code node kept in the mocks).

zones.title: Book
zones.body: Required fields, then the FULL probe (409), then a confirmation code hashed from the idempotency key. Bookings persist in ar_mock_bookings.

zones.title: Bookings by VIN
zones.body: Lists bookings for reschedule and cancel flows.

panels.title: Mock DealerBook
panels.body: Five endpoints under ar-mock/dealerbook/*. Dealers are rows in ar_mock_dealers (seeded by AR-90). Slots are deterministic per dealer and date. A slotId containing FULL returns 409. Bookings persist in ar_mock_bookings.
